Distribution. With the exception of a single male collected in Waimano in the Koʻolau Mountains over a century ago, Limua pahole is known exclusively from the northern Waiʻanae Mountains, in and around Pahole Natural Area Reserve at elevations between ca. 550 – 670 m. This area contains some of the most intact remaining mesic forest and perhaps the largest wild population of olopua anywhere on Oʻahu.
